olivia: quick async standup — GPU headroom check for EMEA/US regions
olivia: what I did: rebalanced nodeclass sizes in us-west to free up 4 GPUs for rd-queue, bumped eviction threshold to 0.72
olivia: blockers: waiting on quota bump for ams-region (requested via ticket #4521) — cloud says they need justification numbers
olivia: today: will generate per-queue token-hour projection and add to the ticket, and validate fallback to cpu-gold for low-priority jobs
sam: noted — I can pull the token-hour numbers from the billing export and annotate the ticket this afternoon
sam: did a quick check: us-east currently has ~12% spare p3 capacity but fragmentation means we only get 6 usable GPUs for contiguous jobs
sam: suggestion: try node packing with `nodeClass: gpu-large` for rd-queue to reduce fragmentation
cheng: re: ams quota — I can provide the SLO impact summary (p50 latency delta if we get <x GPUs). Do you want me to add that to #4521?
olivia: yes please, cheng — if you can include 7/30-day demand curves that helps their quota team
maria: FYI I tested spot fallback yesterday on staging: it worked but cold-starts added ~1.1s median for prefix caching warmups
maria: no errors, but we saw increased KV cache misses when we changed packing profile
ate (infra-bot): deploy 2026.03.17-09:21: service/gpu-scheduler rolled to canary 3 hosts in eu-west; health OK
ate (infra-bot): alert suppressed: gpu-preempt 3x in last 30m on canary hosts; automated reschedule active
ate (infra-bot): linked ticket #4530 for canary preempt logs
sam: blocker for me: need approval for automated quota retry logic in scheduler — current plan retries every 30s x3 then falls back. Security wants review of retry bounds
ate (infra-bot): quota request #4521 moved to awaiting-info by cloud-portal; deadline 2026-03-19
ate (infra-bot): quota advice: include historical peak+growth, affected services list, and mitigation plan
ate (infra-bot): recommended template: `peak_last_30d,peak_projection_30d,workload_tags`
cheng: I'll draft the SLO note and mitigation (canary rollbacks + fallback models) and drop into the ticket tonight
maria: small ask — can someone run a quick audit of models pinned to `quantized-v2` in eu-west? yesterday's canary uncovered a mismatch for model x-4q
ate (infra-bot): audit job started: models-audit/eu-west/quantized-v2 at 1815010005; ETA ~8m
ate (infra-bot): audit results: 3 mismatches (x-4q pinned but binary v1); created ticket #4532 to reconcile
ate (infra-bot): linked logs: https://logs.internal/recon/4532
ate: removing myself from blocking list for the quota ticket — ping me if you want me to draft the cloud-justification template
ate: also left a draft PR for scheduler retry bounds in `infra/scheduler#312`
olivia: thanks all — plan of record: cheng + sam add SLO + billing numbers to #4521, maria verifies quantized pin reconciliations in #4532, I'll cut a canary for rd-queue with node packing changes after PR review
ate: marking this thread as done-for-now — update in channel if new blockers pop up :thumbsup:
sam: noted, will follow up after billing export finishes
cheng: will post SLO doc by 1800 UTC
maria: will run the eu-west audit follow-ups and link PRs
olivia: closing the loop — if quota comes back with questions, I'll hop on a quick sync. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
